title: Programmable design of functional proteins from natural language.
authors: Dai, Fengyuan; You, Shiyang; Zhu, Yudian; Gao, Yuan; Fu, Lihao; Zhou, Xibin; Su, Jin; Wang, Chentong; Fan, Yuliang; Tan, Qingsong; Ma, Xiaoxiao; Deng, Xianjun; Yu, Letong; Qian, Hui; He, Yan; Ke, Yitao; Zhang, Zhe; Han, Chenchen; Chang, Xing; Zheng, Liangzhen; Wang, Sheng; Ji, Yuan; Hao, Kexin; Cao, Longxing; Wang, Yajie; Zeng, Anping; Wang, Shunzhi; Zhan, Chunjun; Zhao, Jing; Si, Tong; Liu, Jianming; Lu, Hongyuan; Yuan, Fajie
one_liner_zh: 该文提出16B参数的自然语言驱动蛋白设计基础模型Pinal，从功能描述直接生成蛋白序列与结构，并在荧光蛋白、酶等任务中实验验证，属于蛋白质结构/序列设计核心课题，方法创新性强。
abstract: Programming biological function-designing bespoke proteins to perform specified molecular tasks-is a foundational goal of molecular engineering. However, current design models remain fundamentally limited(1-3): they typically require either natural proteins as starting points for optimization or manual reformulation of functional goals as geometric and sequence-level constraints to guide candidate generation. Here we introduce Pinal, a 16-billion-parameter foundation model that designs candidate proteins from natural-language descriptions of desired function. Trained on 1.7 billion synthetically annotated protein-text pairs, Pinal links functional intent to protein sequence and structure. In computational evaluations, generated candidates combined high predicted foldability with functional-description alignment and sequence diversity, providing a basis for prioritizing experimentally testable designs. We applied Pinal to four distinct design tasks-a fluorescent protein, a polyethylene terephthalate hydrolase, an alcohol dehydrogenase and a metabolic H-protein-and experimentally observed the intended function in each case, including catalytic activity for both designed enzymes. Without iterative experimental optimization, a Pinal-designed H-protein increased product titre by 1.7-fold relative to the corresponding native Escherichia coli H-protein in a multi-enzyme CO(2) fixation pathway. These findings support natural language as a high-level interface for candidate generation in protein design, enabling programmable exploration with reduced reliance on manually specified structural or sequence constraints.
abstract_zh: 编程生物功能——设计定制蛋白质以执行特定分子任务——是分子工程的基础目标。然而，当前设计模型仍存在根本性局限(1-3)：它们通常需要天然蛋白质作为优化起点，或将功能目标手动重构为几何和序列级约束以指导候选生成。在此，我们引入Pinal，一个160亿参数的基础模型，能够从所需功能的自然语言描述中设计候选蛋白质。基于17亿个合成注释的蛋白质-文本对进行训练，Pinal将功能意图与蛋白质序列和结构相连接。在计算评估中，生成的候选物结合了高预测可折叠性、功能描述对齐性和序列多样性，为优先选择可实验测试的设计提供了基础。我们将Pinal应用于四个不同的设计任务——荧光蛋白、聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯水解酶、醇脱氢酶和代谢H-蛋白——并在每种情况下实验观察到预期功能，包括两种设计酶的催化活性。无需迭代实验优化，Pinal设计的H-蛋白在多酶CO(2)固定途径中，相对于相应的天然大肠杆菌H-蛋白，将产物滴度提高了1.7倍。这些发现支持自然语言作为蛋白质设计中候选生成的高级接口，能够减少对手动指定结构或序列约束的依赖，实现可编程探索。
